purpose: A pending detached middle receives THROW while its simple-CV yield-from result owns a child object. Observe caller identity, unchanged getters, cache snapshots and explicit-close cleanup without a later resume.
source:
<?php
class PendingOwningThrowCache29 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
class PendingOwningThrowReturn29 { function __destruct() { echo "R|"; } }
function pendingOwningThrowLeaf29() { echo "C|"; yield new PendingOwningThrowCache29(); echo "L|"; return new PendingOwningThrowReturn29(); }
function pendingOwningThrowMiddle29() { try { echo "M|"; $reply = yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-BODY|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function pendingOwningThrowOuter29() { try { echo "O|"; yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
$injected = new Exception("pending29"); $child = pendingOwningThrowLeaf29(); $middle = pendingOwningThrowMiddle29(); $outer = pendingOwningThrowOuter29();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); $child->next(); $held = $middle->current(); echo "H|", $held instanceof PendingOwningThrowCache29 ? 1 : 0, "|"; unset($child); echo "T|";
try { $snapshot = $middle->throw($injected); echo "BAD-RETURN|"; } catch (Exception $caught) { echo "CALLER|", $caught === $injected ? 1 : 0, "|", $caught->getPrevious() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
echo "GET|", $middle->current() === $held ? 1 : 0, "|", $middle->key() === null ? 1 : 0, "|", $middle->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|";
unset($outer); echo "OUT|"; unset($middle); echo "MID|"; unset($held); echo "HELD|"; unset($caught, $injected); echo "E";

purpose: Argument evaluation drops every Generator alias after selecting the pending detached middle. Its copied owning array return and distinct cached destructor expose snapshot retirement, supplied-exception replacement and previous identity before catch.

<?php
class PendingOwningThrowLate29 { function __destruct() { echo "R|"; } }
class PendingOwningThrowReplaceCache29 { function __destruct() { echo "D|"; throw new Exception("replacement29"); } }
function pendingOwningThrowReplaceLeaf29() { echo "C|"; yield new PendingOwningThrowReplaceCache29(); echo "L|"; return [new PendingOwningThrowLate29()]; }
function pendingOwningThrowReplaceMiddle29() { try { echo "M|"; $reply = yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-BODY|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function pendingOwningThrowReplaceOuter29() { try { echo "O|"; yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function pendingOwningThrowDrop29() { unset($GLOBALS["outer"], $GLOBALS["middle"], $GLOBALS["child"]); echo "DROP|"; return $GLOBALS["injected"]; }
$injected = new Exception("pending29"); $child = pendingOwningThrowReplaceLeaf29(); $middle = pendingOwningThrowReplaceMiddle29(); $outer = pendingOwningThrowReplaceOuter29();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); $child->next(); echo "H|", $middle->current() instanceof PendingOwningThrowReplaceCache29 ? 1 : 0, "|"; unset($child); echo "T|";
try { $snapshot = $middle->throw(pendingOwningThrowDrop29()); echo "BAD-RETURN|"; }
catch (Exception $caught) { echo "CALLER|", $caught->getMessage() === "replacement29" ? 1 : 0, "|", $caught->getPrevious() === $injected ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
unset($caught, $injected); echo "E";
